items.content_html: Neural network interpretability: Grassmannian block-sparse featurizer to preserve the class probabilities of DINOv3 + Imagenette classifier. The pipeline extracts final patch activations, replaces them with BSF reconstructions, and minimizes KL(original || reconstructed). Only the BSF updates. Combines Goodfire's BSFs with Apollo's end-to-end SAEs.
